# generated/ — DO NOT EDIT

Everything here is produced by the pipeline (`data_analysis/thesis_pipeline/`).
Edit the sources, not these files. Regenerate with `python build_thesis.py`.

- `results.json` — the assembled registry (manual constants + computed values).
- `values.tex`   — `\val...` macros; `\input` it from the preamble.
- `tables/`      — generated LaTeX tables (when added).
- `figs/`        — generated figures (when `make_figures.py` targets this dir).
